name: code-factory
description: Agent skills for dynamic software delivery: spec writing, worktree-parallel workflow execution, cross-model adversarial review, and PR babysitting

interface.shortDescription: Dynamic software delivery: specs, autonomous workflow execution, adversarial review, PR babysitting
interface.longDescription: Skills for turning rough ideas into merged PRs. Write EARS-format design specs with adversarial spec review, deliver them autonomously through dynamic workflows (worktree-parallel implementers, cross-model adversarial code review, deterministic phase-boundary verification), drive the Codex MCP with a verified known-good configuration, babysit PRs and PR stacks (Graphite and gh-stack) to green, and audit test suites for low-value tests.
defaultPrompt: Use Code Factory to write a design spec for my feature
Execute this approved spec as a dynamic workflow
Babysit my PR stack until everything is green
